<x_0.0645><y_0.7617>Now, in other to find the value of P or a complete oscillation, we must divide the oscillation into two parts, the first from B to A, where the force of torsion accelerates the velocity _u_, while the retarded force, arising from the resistance of the air and the imper- flection of elasticity, diminishes the velocity _u_, and the<x_0.4541><y_0.8484><class_Text>

<x_0.4697><y_0.0617>second from A to B’, where the force of torsion, as well as the other forces, concerner in diminishing _n_ or retarding the motion.<x_0.8662><y_0.1039><class_Text>

<x_0.4688><y_0.1047>347. _Ex._ 1. If S=m×A--M’, we shall have for the state of motion in the first portion BA<x_0.8545><y_0.132><class_Text>

<x_0.4678><y_0.1328>\(n\times 2\Lambda M-M+\frac{2m\lambda A-M^{+1}}{+1+}\frac{zm\lambda^+1}{+1+}=\omega t\int p^a^a^a\)<x_0.8555><y_0.1641><class_Formula>

<x_0.4668><y_0.1633>Hence, when the angle of torsion becomes equal to no- thing, or A--M=0, we have<x_0.8535><y_0.1938><class_Text>

<x_0.5391><y_0.1969>\(n\Delta^+\frac{2m\lambda^+1}{++1}=\UU\int p^a^a^a^a,\)<x_0.7637><y_0.2328><class_Formula>

<x_0.4658><y_0.2313>which dividing by \(\int^p^p^a\), becomes<x_0.7139><y_0.257><class_Text>

<x_0.5312><y_0.2617>\(U!=\frac{n\Delta^+\frac{2m\lambda^+1}{++1}}\)<x_0.7051><y_0.3281><class_Formula>

<x_0.4648><y_0.332>Let us now consider the other part of the motion from A to B’, and suppose the angle AC U=M, we shall find, by calling U the velocity of the point A,<x_0.8564><y_0.375><class_Text>

<x_0.5068><y_0.3773>\(nMP^a}{2}++\frac{M^kr^+r+1}=\U^{-a^*}/\sum\int^p^p^a^r.\)<x_0.7988><y_0.4109><class_Formula>

<x_0.4639><y_0.4125>Then, by substituting instead of U its value as lately found, and taking the floants, we shall have, when the velocity vanishes, or when the oscillation is finished,<x_0.8574><y_0.457><class_Text>

<x_0.5078><y_0.4602>\(\Delta-M=\frac{2m}{nx++2}\times\frac{A^{+++}M^{+1}}{+1+},\)<x_0.7666><y_0.4898><class_Formula>

<x_0.4629><y_0.4945>and if the retarding forces are such, that at each oscilla- tion, the amplitude is a little diminished, we shall have for the approximate value of A--M<x_0.8584><y_0.5383><class_Text>

<x_0.5732><y_0.543>\(\Lambda-M=\frac{2m\lambda}{n\px++i}\),<x_0.7129><y_0.5734><class_Formula>

<x_0.4648><y_0.5781>and if the angle A--M is so small that it may be treated as a common flatened quantity, we shall then have for any number of oscillations<x_0.8564><y_0.6195><class_Text>

<x_0.5><y_0.6234>\(N\times\frac{2m}{nx++1}=\frac{1}{1+}\times\frac{1}{M^{+-i}}+\frac{1}{A^{+1}}.\)<x_0.7822><y_0.6602><class_Formula>

<x_0.4619><y_0.6641>where M represents the angle to which A becomes equal after any number of oscillations N. Hence we obtain<x_0.8564><y_0.7055><class_Text>

<x_0.5098><y_0.7063>\(M=\frac{1}{(N\times\frac{2m\lambda+1}{n\times+1}+\frac{1}{A^{+1}})\times\frac{1}{r+1}\),<x_0.7998><y_0.7578><class_Formula>

<x_0.4707><y_0.7602>which determines the value of M after any number of oscillations N.<x_0.8594><y_0.7883><class_Text>

<x_0.2344><y_0.8594>\(n\times\Delta-M=\frac{2m}{r+1}\times\frac{A^{++}+M^{+1}}{++m}/\times\frac{A^{++}xM^{+1}}{A+M}.\)<x_0.6709><y_0.8961><class_Formula>
